ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of child care fraud, including allegations of embezzlement and false claims.
questions: How much money is involved in child care fraud?
What are the most common schemes used to commit child care fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover new information about the scope and complexity of child care fraud, and provide insight into the financial motivations behind the crimes.
